metric: Per wire:navigate, ms from Livewire.navigate() call: nav = livewire:navigated event; content = first matching element (table tbody tr for /employees and /contracts, a Livewire component inside #main-content for /); overlayGone = #page-gif-overlay absent or display:none; firstUseful = max(content, overlayGone), as in X1 measure.py.
target: X2 session copy (synthetic SQLite, *@example.test), php -S single worker on 127.0.0.1:8391, HR-ALP persona, Chromium (Claude desktop built-in browser), pane-sized desktop viewport, warm.
method: 5 rounds of /employees -> /contracts -> / ; each navigation starts only after no new resource request for 700 ms (settled). Before = A7 changes stashed and assets rebuilt; after = A7 changes applied and assets rebuilt. Same session, same data.
caveat: Absolute times swing between runs on this machine (an unsettled before run gave /employees content 1022 ms median, the settled before run 1607 ms, with no code change). Compare hidden = overlayGone - content, not absolute load times.

before_unsettled_first_run.note: Fixed 400 ms gap between navigations, no settling. Kept for disclosure; not used for comparison.

after_unsettled_discarded.note: Same fixed 400 ms gap after the change: next navigation queued behind the previous page's photo requests on the single-worker server, so nav times rose (e.g. /contracts ~2800 ms). Diagnosed as a measurement artefact and replaced by the settled method; recorded here so it is not hidden.
